title: bash gate misses a file verb after a leading redirect, a subscripted prefix, a case label or a keyword before a continued line
detail: Sentinel advisories on v0.238.0; v0.237.1 did not read these verbs at all. '>o rm a', '2>/dev/null rm a' and '<in rm a' leave rm unseen because a redirect before the command word is not skipped. 'X[0]=1 rm a' fails _ENV_WORD_RE. 'case x in x) rm a;; esac' is unseen because ')' starts no statement. 'until\<newline> rm a' is unseen. _MUTATION_RE is quadratic on an unclosed subscript ('a[ ' repeated, 2.6s at 48KB), so bound its subscript. L3: 'S=-t; cp $S design a' passes a flag through a variable, so the parser names only a. All in _command_starts, _verb_operands and _MUTATION_RE.
